# laminar_dataset (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laminar dataset by `id` or exact `name`. Lookup by name fails when several datasets share it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laminar_dataset" "golden" {
  name = "golden-set"
}

output "golden_dataset_id" {
  value = data.laminar_dataset.golden.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Dataset UUID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Exact dataset name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project that owns the dataset.
